audit.whatIsWrong: diff says FAV but diffRating says 8/10 and breakdown.difficulty/report[14] say 'Hard matchup', against a 66.67% win rate. Separately, every one of the seven chart rows disagrees with the packet chart AND with the content layer's own whys[].
audit.why: whys[0] says neither side wants a level-1 brawl (page renders Neeko), whys[1]-whys[3] describe Neeko poke windows (page renders Skill/Ambessa/Ambessa), whys[4] says her level 6 flips it (page renders Neeko), whys[5] says even-or-better (page renders Ambessa), whys[6] says you scale into a bomb (page renders Ambessa). The packet chart matches the whys exactly.
audit.corrected: diffRating 4/10, carryRating 7/10, difficulty text to 'Favoured matchup', tone to the favourable colour, and all seven rows set to Skill/Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Ambessa/Skill/Neeko as matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was rendered as a Neeko spike while the text says her spike flips the lane, and the first-item row named Stormsurge while the content layer builds Blackfire Torch.
audit.why: Public Execution is 130/115/100s, blinks to the farthest champion in a line at 1250 range, suppresses on arrival and then stuns — that is the single largest spike in the lane and it is hers.
audit.corrected: phases[4] rebuilt on Public Execution's range and cooldown; phases[5] on the Blackfire race; report[9] switched from Stormsurge to Blackfire to match the content layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer tracks a fabricated ability called 'Dash Chain' in twelve places — winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[1].t, dosFull[2].d and four report entries. Ambessa has no such ability. Separately mid, wants.you[1] and wants.foe[1] claim Neeko has 'Shapesplitter (W) invisibility'; her W sends a redirectable clone, and spikes[3] refers to 'shield-up clone plays' when Neeko has no shield.
audit.why: The tracked cooldown a player reads before every step-up was a name that does not exist. Her real dash is the Drakehound's Step passive, which fires off any cast and grants an empowered next attack — the wind-up is the tell, not the ability.
audit.corrected: 'Dash Chain' replaced with Public Execution where the field means her ult and with Drakehound's Step where it means the dash weave; Repudiation named as the shield she absorbs the root-trade with; invisibility replaced with Inherent Glamour (the disguise, which hides Pop Blossom's preparation) and with the clone.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer refers to Ambessa as 'he/his' while the content layer uses 'she/her'.
audit.corrected: Fixed on the prose fields that carried it.

notes: 'Dash Chain' is a fabricated Ambessa ability that the full layer tracked in twelve fields, including focus.text and loading — the exact strings a player reads on the loading screen. Her real abilities are Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E), Public Execution (R). All seven chart rows were wrong in BOTH layers and both layers agreed with each other, so no existing mirror check would have caught it; the packet chart and the content whys[] already agreed, and I set the rows to that. The 'Shapesplitter invisibility' claim recurs here as it did on aatrox/akali/akshan — Neeko's W has no invisibility in Riot's text. tone was proposed as the favourable colour to match FAV and the corrected 4/10; if the palette maps differently, that one edit can be dropped without affecting anything else. I did NOT act on the missingInteractions 'needs-antiheal' item: the heal flag on Public Execution is derived, and Riot's description of that ability mentions no healing at all.
